# Petal Knot

## Overview

Add a petal (petaluma) knot: 2k+1 petals around a single
multi-crossing, the knot type given by the permutation of
strand heights through the centre.

## Options

<!-- options: generated by docs/scaffold_pages.py -->

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Knot | Trefoil 3_1 | Named petal permutation, a seeded random one, or your own. Unknot, Trefoil 3_1, Figure Eight 4_1, Cinquefoil 5_1, Three-Twist 5_2, Torus Knot T(3,4) = 8_19, Septafoil 7_1, Torus Knot T(4,5) = 10_124, and 2 more. |
| Petals | 7 | Number of petals 2k+1 for the random model (evens are rounded up to odd) Range 3-21. |
| Permutation | `1 3 5 2 4` | Custom heights of the passes through the centre, e.g. '1 3 5 2 4': a permutation of 1..N, N odd; N sets the petal count |
| Seed | 0 | Random-permutation seed |
| Petal Radius | 1 | Radius of the circle of petal tips Range 0.05-10. |
| Height Spread | 0.35 | Half-range of the strand heights at the centre; raise it (or thin the tube) for many petals Range 0.02-2. |
| Samples / Petal | 64 | Curve samples per petal Range 8-512. |
| Output | Bezier Curve | Bezier Curve, Poly Curve, NURBS Curve, Mesh Tube. |
| Tube Radius | 0.035 | Curve bevel depth / tube radius (keep below half the centre height gap spread/(N-1)) Range 0-1. |
| Bevel Resolution | 6 | Range 1-16. |
| Tube Sides | 12 | Range 3-32. |
| Scale | 1 | Range 0.01-100. |

<!-- /options -->

## References

- Colin Adams, Thomas Crawford, Benjamin DeMeo, Michael Landry,
- Alex Tong Lin, MurphyKate Montee, Seojung Park, Saraswathi
- Venkatesh, Farrah Yhee, "Knot projections with a single
- multi-crossing", Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications
- 24(3), 1550011, 2015 (arXiv:1208.5742) -- petal projections and
- the petal number.
- Chaim Even-Zohar, Joel Hass, Nathan Linial, Tahl Nowik,
- "Invariants of random knots and links", Discrete & Computational
- Geometry 56(2), 274-314, 2016 (arXiv:1411.3308) -- the Petaluma
- model: random knots from random petal permutations.
- Chaim Even-Zohar, "Models of random knots", Journal of Applied
- and Computational Topology 1, 263-296, 2017 -- survey, including
- the petal-permutation model.
